summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine weekly update on its share repurchase program announced on June 9, 2026. Between August 10-14, 2026, the company repurchased 107,871 ordinary shares at an average price of EUR 24.14 per share, totaling EUR 2.6 million, with prices ranging from EUR 22.88 to EUR 24.98. After these purchases, Lakefront holds 916,057 treasury shares. The repurchases were executed across Euronext Amsterdam and other trading venues via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary. This is an ordinary capital return disclosure, not a special situation event.
